title: Roasted Celeriac Gratin
description: A creamy, comforting side dish made with roasted celeriac and topped with a crunchy dutch cheese gratin.
instructions: Toss celeriac slices with 2 tbsp of oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
In a separate saucepan, melt 2 tbsp of butter over medium heat.
Add chopped spring onions and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in grated gouda cheese until melted and well combined.
In a greased 8-inch square baking dish, create a layer of roasted celeriac slices.
Spread the cheese and onion mixture over the celeriac layer.
Bake in the preheated oven for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
